info.title: Wholesale Order & VAT Reporting API
info.description:
Order management and VAT reporting for a wholesale business.

Authenticate with `POST /auth/token` (username + password), then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Roles: **admin** (users, tax rates, settings, audit log, plus everything staff can do) and **staff**
(customers, orders, payments, refunds, reports). Money is returned as exact decimal strings.
Default tax preset: China VAT (2026 VAT Law); rates are data in the `tax_rates` table, please confirm with your accountant.
